words.gloss: a support staff or walking stick

literal: Like a support staff in a place that has slipping, are the words from the mouth of those who possess good conduct.
translation: The words from the mouth of those who possess disciplined conduct are like a supporting staff on slippery ground.
modern: வழுக்கல் நிறைந்த இடத்தில் ஊன்றுகோல் உதவுவது போல, நல்ல ஒழுக்கம் உடையவர்களின் வாயிலிருந்து வரும் சொற்கள் வாழ்க்கையின் தடுமாற்றங்களில் துணையாக உதவும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the protective value of listening to virtuous people. Just as a walking staff prevents a person from slipping and falling on wet, unstable ground, the wise words spoken by those of disciplined conduct act as a reliable support during difficult times. Listening to their guidance saves one from moral and practical downfalls in life.
